About Us
Scorpion is the leading provider of technology and services helping local businesses thrive. We do this by helping customers understand local market dynamics, make the most of their marketing, and deliver experiences their customers will love. We offer tools to know what’s going on with marketing, competitors, and customers. We offer a unique blend of AI support and teams of real human people with local expertise committed to customer success. At Scorpion, we are ready to do whatever it takes to help our clients reach their goals. Our technology and personalized tools bring everything together to help local businesses easily understand their unique business, market, and customer needs. We put SEO, Reviews, Advertising, Email Marketing, Chat and Messaging, Social Media, Website, Lead Management, Appointment Scheduling, and more to work for local businesses. We’re a technology-led service with a human touch.
About the Role
As a Growth Advisor, you will sell innovative Scorpion AI technology to small businesses, making powerful digital solutions more accessible to businesses looking to grow. This role offers the opportunity to be part of an evolving sales model that helps businesses get started with technology that fits their needs today, with the flexibility to expand their marketing services as they grow.
As a Growth Advisor, you’ll take a consultative, relationship-driven approach, helping business owners understand their challenges, recognize opportunities for growth, and see how Scorpion’s technology can support their goals.
You’ll specialize in an assigned industry vertical, allowing you to develop a deep understanding of your customers and their unique needs. With a straightforward product offering, set pricing, and no complex packages to configure or discounts to negotiate, you can focus on what matters most: building trust, demonstrating value, and helping small businesses take the next step in their growth journey.
This is an exciting opportunity for a sales professional who enjoys building relationships, working in a high-volume environment, and helping bring a new offering to market. You’ll play a key role in expanding Scorpion’s reach, connecting more businesses with accessible technology, and contributing to the growth of an evolving business initiative.
What Your Success Will Look Like
Support our team culture by working in the office 5 days a week. This means you’ll have to live within commuting distance of our Valencia, CA office.
Complete and report 50-70 daily outbound activities.
Work from an assigned list of businesses within your industry vertical, supported by company-generated leads.
Manage the full sales cycle using the Scorpion Sales Playbook.
Build meaningful business relationships with prospects, clients, and your Scorpion colleagues.
Use the various training platforms to continuously grow your personal knowledge of our product, sales and process.
Develop and maintain a strong understanding of your assigned industry vertical.

Compensation
We acknowledge that states have passed legislation promoting pay transparency. As a national employer, Scorpion has made the decision to post our expected pay rate or pay range (as applicable) in all our job postings, regardless of geographic location.
The base salary is $55,000 (entry-level) - $65,000 (highly experienced). This position's annual variable is $35,000 (entry-level) - $40,000 (highly experienced), exclusive of fringe benefits. If you are hired at Scorpion, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. Additionally, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider the internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer.  Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the total salary + annual variable range for the role.
